reviews.name: Priya Sharma
reviews.text: I was stuck between two job offers and anxious about timing. Acharyaa Ankush explained my dasha in plain language and told me which window actually favoured a switch. I took the offer he flagged — and the first three months matched what he described. Calm, precise, no drama.

reviews.name: Rohit Mehta
reviews.text: I had been making the same money mistakes every year. He showed the pattern in the chart, gave two practical remedies, and a period to be extra careful with investments. Within weeks I felt clearer. This is not fortune-telling — it is structured advice.

reviews.name: Ananya Iyer
reviews.text: We needed an honest kundli match, not a rubber stamp. He pointed out both strengths and friction points, and what could be worked on. Our families finally had a conversation based on facts instead of fear. Grateful for the honesty.

reviews.name: Vikram Singh
reviews.text: The comprehensive session covered career, family and health in one sitting. I received a clear timeline and simple remedies I could actually follow. Follow-up on WhatsApp was prompt. 2,000+ happy clients makes sense once you sit with him.

reviews.name: Sneha Patel
reviews.text: I came in confused about a long relationship. He did not tell me what I wanted to hear — he told me what the chart showed, then how to handle the next six months. That honesty saved me months of second-guessing.

reviews.name: Aarav Kapoor
reviews.text: Not a medical diagnosis — he was clear about that — but the periods he marked for extra rest lined up with how I had been feeling. The remedies were simple. I now plan check-ups around those windows instead of ignoring them.

reviews.name: Meera Joshi
reviews.text: Spoke from Pune on a video call. Birth details were checked first, then he walked through the chart house by house. I could ask follow-up questions live. Felt like talking to an engineer who also happens to read kundlis.

reviews.name: Name withheld by request
reviews.text: Business decisions were stalling and family pressure was high. The PDF report plus the call gave me a map for 18 months. We have already resolved two of the three issues I came with. Quiet, professional, and very sharp.

reviews.name: Karan Malhotra
reviews.text: I was about to resign in frustration. He asked me to wait eight weeks and tighten one habit. A better internal role opened exactly in that window. I tell people: if you want guesswork, go elsewhere.
